optimizedDescription.value: ListDiscarded returns discarded ChangeRepository list entries unchanged; default limit 100; no content.

optimizedContext.value:
# List Discarded

## Rules
- `ListDiscarded.execute(options?)` MUST return `ListResult<DiscardedChangeListEntry>` for discarded changes
- Forward `ListOptions`, `includeDescription`, `includeReason`, `includeSupersededBy` to `ChangeRepository.listDiscarded()` unchanged; no re-sort/filter/paginate; order=`discardedAt` desc owned by repo index
- Default `limit` **100** when options omitted
- Return `DiscardedChangeListEntry` — NOT `DiscardedChangeView`, NOT mutable `Change`
- Entries MUST NOT include artifact content, history, derived artifact state maps; detail via `getDiscarded(name)`
- Optional `description`/`reason`/`supersededBy` only when include flags set and repo projected them
- Constructor sole dep: `ChangeRepository`; return `listDiscarded(options)` unchanged
- Empty → `{ items: [], meta: { total: 0, count: 0, limit: <resolved> } }`; MUST NOT throw
- `createListDiscarded(config)` MUST preserve complete artifact-type + spec-existence bootstrap; MUST NOT weaker variant
- Config form → `resolveListDiscardedDeps(resolver)` → `createListDiscarded(deps)`; resolve `changes: ChangeRepository`; MUST NOT inline fs wiring

## Constraints
- Read-only list pass-through; repository owns order/filter/pagination
